steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const Field=(await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field;const m=Field.world().map;const path=[];const tryStep=(x,z)=>{const t=m.tileAt(x,z);return {x,z,solid:!!(t&&t.solid),ground:t&&t.ground,exit:!!m.exitAt(x,z)};};for(let z=23;z<=28.5;z+=0.5)path.push(tryStep(15.5,z));window.__PATH=path;__DQ.face(0);__DQ.cameraOrbit(180);await sleep(300);const trail=[];for(let i=0;i<12&&__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick';i++){const p=__DQ.state().player;trail.push({i,x:+p.x.toFixed(2),z:+p.z.toFixed(2),blocked:!!p.blocked,map:__DQ.state().map.id});__DQ.hold('up',700);await sleep(850);}trail.push({done:true,map:__DQ.state().map.id,player:__DQ.state().player&&{x:+__DQ.state().player.x.toFixed(2),z:+__DQ.state().player.z.toFixed(2)}});window.__TRAIL=trail;return JSON.stringify({path,trail});})()
